caseNameFull: WHITE, OF THE ESTATE OF SMITH v. UNITED STATES
attorneys: Kenneth A. Payment argued the cause for petitioner. With him on the briefs was James M. White, pro se., Alan I. Horowitz argued the cause for respondents. With him on the brief were Solicitor General Starr, Assistant Attorney General Peterson, Deputy Solicitor General Wallace, Charles E. Brookhart, and Joan I. Oppenheimer.*

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The writ of certiorari is dismissed as improvidently granted.

Justice White dissents.
